name: Herrera de Alcántara (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white in the proportions 1:2, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Herrera de Alcántara (flames on red and a cross of Alcántara on white).
history: Municipal flag of Herrera de Alcántara; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Herrera de Alcántara arms — flames and cross of Alcántara
